messages:
sophie_csm: Heads up 10:05 PDT7: we saw a spike in ingestion queue latency affecting ~42 tenants; about 9 are flagged as high-risk for upcoming renewals. Id like a quick external comms + an offer plan (re-runs + credit). Thoughts?

maria_cs: Oof. Can you list the high-risk tenants in the tracker? Ill prep targeted comms.

tom_support: Support tickets created CS-8210..CS-8251. Auto-notifications to tenants were suppressed to avoid noisy alerts.

eng_reliability: Quick status: root cause appears to be a combined edge S3 503 window + our prefix-merge op retrying without jitter. That caused >50% duplicate retries and blocked the ingestion worker pool. We applied a temporary queue-concurrency cap at 10:45; ingest rate recovered by 11:15.

sre_oncall: We're rolling a safe patch (adds exponential backoff + idempotency guard) that should go to canary in ~3 hours and full deploy within 12 hours if tests pass.

alan_support_bot: Linked tickets to CS cases and annotated with tag: onboard-latency-2026-03. Created follow-ups for manual re-runs.

jake_sales: For the top 9, Ill call the AE owners and offer a prioritized re-run + a renewal assurance note. Do we want to proactively offer a credit or wait for replies?

sophie_csm: Proactive credit for trials (1-month) and prioritization for paid high-touch is fine. Add explicit "renewal-bridge" language: we will prioritize activation to avoid any renewal impact.

maria_cs: Drafting two short messages now (high-touch and generic). Keeping tone: apologetic, actionable, and minimal technical detail. Pasting drafts: 

maria_cs: ```
High-touch (named AE outreach)
Hi <Name>,
Were sorry  earlier today your onboarding upload experienced delays. Weve applied mitigations and can schedule a prioritized re-run this week at no cost to ensure activation ahead of your renewal. Please reply with the upload ID or let us pick a window. Well follow up with a short RCA and a dedicated office-hours slot if youd like a walkthrough.
Thanks,
<CSM>

Generic (automated to trials)
Hi,
We observed a temporary delay with data uploads earlier today which may have delayed ingestion. The issue is mitigated and your workspace should be back to normal. If youd like us to re-run your upload or need help, reply and well assist. Were providing a 1-month credit for affected trial accounts.
The Redwood Inference Team
```

eng_reliability: Minor ask: when you request re-runs include the original upload ID and upload timestamp so support can dedupe. Also mention we will share an RCA within 48 hours.

maria_cs: Will add upload ID note. Action items: 1) Maria send high-touch emails to 9 AEs now, 2) Sophie queue automated trial emails, 3) Support to run re-runs only on explicit request with upload ID, 4) Eng posts RCA draft within 48 hrs, 5) Offer 1-month credit to affected trials and prioritized activation for high-touch.

alan_support_bot: Support runbook step created: "re-run-on-demand: include upload_id; confirm dedupe flag".

jake_sales: AE outreach in progress. Im noting ARR at risk and will surface any urgent renewals to GTM leadership.

sophie_csm: Sending high-touch now. Outbound will include a one-click calendar for an immediate re-run slot and a 1-question feedback form link: https://redwood.company/quick-survey/onboard-2026.

eng_reliability: Well also add a short-term monitoring dashboard to surface duplicate retry spikes. ETA ~24h.

sre_oncall: Logging full timeline in the incident tracker and tagging execs. Will update when canary deploy completes.

maria_cs: Thanks team. Ill post a follow-up with any customer replies and escalate renewals that look vulnerable. Please keep RCA timeline to 48 hours so we can close the loop with customers quickly. :pray:
